plays: SOXL: Your -51.56% loss on this leveraged ETF is significant. Consider trimming or exiting SOXL to reduce exposure to decay and margin risk.
SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is already down -28.55%. Review your stop at 21.38 and consider tightening it to protect capital.

No new buys today - hold and watch. While chip news is positive, no scanner setup has a compelling enough catalyst to warrant a new buy recommendation right now, especially with existing leveraged positions needing attention.
